blocks.text: 07-LPG / landing pages and funnels Goes here. A strategic breakdown of high-performing, high-AOV direct-to-response e-commerce funnels, arguing that "ugly" landing pages convert better when conversion rate and AOV are optimized. Covers funnel architecture (Sales Page -> Order Page -> OTO upsells), research SOPs (Voice of Customer), and core landing page components. Not here. • Email sequence automation or Klaviyo deliverability setup -> 09-EML • Meta ad buying or top-of-funnel ad account scaling -> 06-MEA

Header. url: rights: public_reference why: Details the structural and copywriting framework for constructing high-AOV, multi-step e-commerce sales funnels, emphasizing the psychological necessity of selling transformational outcomes over product features and maximizing post-purchase profit contribution via one-time offers (OTOs). modules: [LPG] topics: [landing pages, funnel architecture, average order value, conversion rate optimization, sales pages, order bumps, one-time offers, OTOs, copywriting, Voice of Customer, VSSL, TSL] tier: 3 scope_hint: comprehensive

Topics. funnel architecture / the transition from sending traffic directly to a standard Product Detail Page (PDP) to routing through a dedicated Sales Page, an Order Page, and sequential post-purchase One-Time Offer (OTO) upsell pages; ugly lander theory / the premise that landing page visual aesthetics matter far less than clean copy and frictionless performance, provided conversion rate and AOV are optimized; post-purchase OTO psychology / leveraging the customer's immediate post-transaction emotional peak and high price elasticity to introduce high-margin upsells (e.g., 10x pricing tiers) that drastically increase profit contribution per customer; Voice of Customer (VoC) research / utilizing AI-driven research prompts and foundational documentation (research docs, offer briefs, avatar sheets, and necessary belief lists) to harvest real consumer language from forums and reviews rather than writing through marketer bias; sales page essentials / structuring landing pages around benefit-driven headlines, urgency, scarcity, risk-reversal guarantees, unique mechanisms, embedded social proof, and FAQs; order page friction reduction / prioritizing speed and minimal friction on checkout pages through quantity breaks and checkout order bumps (e.g., shipping insurance or expedited delivery); OTO structures / utilizing Video Sales Letters (VSLs) or Text Sales Letters (TSLs) driven by core product placement strategies, specifically selling "more of the same" or products that "solve one problem and create another."
The Funnel Architecture Shift: Moving away from standard PDP-to-checkout flows toward Sales Page -> Order Page -> OTO1 -> OTO2 architectures to capture high-margin post-purchase revenue.

The Price Elasticity OTO Rule: The concept that right after a transaction, customer price elasticity is at its highest, allowing brands to offer high-ticket or multi-unit upsells that scale Average Order Value (AOV) significantly.
The "Ugly Lander" Principle: The core argument that copy clarity, speed, and conversion metrics override aesthetic design—ugly landing pages print money if conversion and AOV are healthy.

Solve One Problem, Create Another: The strategic framework for choosing OTO products where the initial front-end product solves a specific customer pain point while naturally creating a brand-new, adjacent problem that the upsell immediately fixes.
Skip. Plugs for the creator's Instagram DM automation, Brand Builders Academy, and references to exterior YouTube videos on quiz funnels.

Scope mix. 10% baseline (landing page definition and basic conversion metrics), 90% growth (advanced direct-response funnel architecture, post-purchase OTO optimization, and Voice of Customer research). Volume. ~450 words.
